note: Knowledge checks are a reading check only. A pass on them is not verified practical competence.

knowledgeAnswers.rationale: A visual inspection is not clearance. The area is excluded and a qualified assessment is requested.
The NSW release lists wet, slippery and unstable surfaces among clean-up hazards.

practicalCriteria: The learner excludes uncleared structural and confined-space areas.
The learner does not treat a visual inspection as structural clearance.
Learner completes the procedure record for the mock case and names the stop-work trigger before any practical step.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Completed mock decision record for the lesson case
Assessor observation of the simulated scenario, with no real site work or hazardous material
stopWorkCriteria: An area is structurally unresolved or undermined.
A confined space is proposed for entry.
